study_identification_part.si4_title: Regional, circuit and network heterogeneity of brain abnormalities in psychiatric disorders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Quantify individual-level gray matter volume (GMV) deviations with normative modeling across six psychiatric disorders and test whether heterogeneous regional deviations converge within common functional circuits and networks.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper clearly describes the datasets used for the healthy control (training) sample across 14 different studies and 25 scan sites. Supplementary Table 1 provides detailed information on each dataset.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Regional GMV deviations are highly idiosyncratic (<7% regional overlap), yet converge within common circuits and networks (up to ~56% of cases), implicating salience–ventral attention and other systems transdiagnostically and by disorder.
